name: motion-atlas-animation-exporter
description: Copy, export, and integrate Motion Atlas animation patterns for developer and design workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Copy and export Motion Atlas animations as Framer, CSS, JSON, or design-tool tokens.
interface.longDescription: A developer-friendly Motion Atlas plugin for copying production animation snippets, exporting animation recipes as JSON or CSS, and mapping motion tokens into design tools such as Figma, Framer, and Lottie-style handoff workflows.
